answer: In this PoA design, each agent identity is bound to a cryptographically attested enclave measurement, MRENCLAVE, and a hardware-protected key verified through remote attestation. Copying a virtual machine cannot reproduce the authorized enclave identity or its attestation evidence; creating another instance requires additional trusted silicon. Consequently, cloning identities entails purchasing physical hardware, while sonnet, ripple, and gale remain harmless labels rather than virtual identities.
